criterion: which banking customer-service intent the query expresses

categories.name: Card Issues
categories.definition: Inquiries related to problems with physical or virtual cards, including activation, reactivation, and functionality.

categories.name: Transfer Issues
categories.definition: Questions or concerns regarding the status, completion, or cancellation of money transfers.

categories.name: Account Management
categories.definition: Requests related to account creation, deletion, or modification of personal details.

categories.name: Fees and Charges
categories.definition: Inquiries about fees associated with transactions, card usage, or account services.

categories.name: Identity Verification
categories.definition: Questions regarding the process and requirements for verifying identity for account access or transactions.

categories.name: Top-Up Issues
categories.definition: Concerns related to adding funds to accounts, including failed top-ups and limits.

categories.name: Currency Exchange
categories.definition: Inquiries about exchanging currencies, including rates and supported currencies.

categories.name: ATM Issues
categories.definition: Problems encountered while using ATMs, including card retention and incorrect cash dispensation.

categories.name: Fraud and Security
categories.definition: Concerns about unauthorized transactions, lost or stolen cards, and potential fraud.

categories.name: Payment Declines
categories.definition: Questions regarding declined payments, including reasons and resolutions.

categories.name: Delivery Issues
categories.definition: Inquiries about the delivery status of cards or other banking materials.

categories.name: Technical Issues
categories.definition: Problems related to the banking app or website functionality.

categories.name: Cash Withdrawal Issues
categories.definition: Concerns regarding cash withdrawals, including amounts dispensed and transaction statuses.

categories.name: Contactless Payment Issues
categories.definition: Questions related to the use and functionality of contactless payment methods.

categories.name: Account Limits
categories.definition: Inquiries about limits on transactions, withdrawals, or account balances.

categories.name: Document Requirements
categories.definition: Questions about necessary documentation for various banking processes.

categories.name: Disputes and Refunds
categories.definition: Requests for information on disputing charges or obtaining refunds.

categories.name: Miscellaneous Inquiries
categories.definition: General questions that do not fit into the other specified categories.
